backlog.title: Widget arrow interaction model v2 — boundary pass-through + interaction carousel
backlog.description: Code-catches-up delta (same shape as the tier-0 run): spec/07 'Widget key handling', SPEC.md invariant 1, and spec/09 are ALREADY at model v2 and are READ-ONLY; only code, tests, the README invariant mirror, and the DoD record change. Boundary pass-through replaces boundary-Esc's consumed press (one press: dismiss + suppress + forward verbatim, caret moves same keypress); the interaction carousel (first highlight-moving arrow press marks the generation interacted; both edges wrap end-to-end) retires the clamp as unreachable. Out of scope: fallback path, core/ modules, config, spec edits, chain semantics, tier/matching, and everything in the PRD §1a landed list.

subtasks.title: WidgetState generation flag + WidgetKeyDecision/decideWidgetKey v2 decision table
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: plan/005_f9498a2d63d5/architecture/system_context.md §'Where the old model lives' + §'Generation state home' + §'CRITICAL pitfall' (line numbers verified at HEAD 23fd764). WidgetKeyDecision is at src/pi/widget.ts:976–983 (variants navigate/boundary-esc/clamp/escape/tab-insert/enter-submit/forward); decideWidgetKey at :999–1018 is PURE — params (data, visible, count, highlightIndex, keybindings?) — currently deciding boundary-esc at up/left i===0 and clamp at down/right i===count−1. WidgetState :278–286; WidgetStateInternal :289–292 (items, hidden); createWidgetState.set() :302–306 resets highlightIndex=0 (:304, 'spec h3.8') — and applyVisibility's signature-compare (:1286–1300) means set() fires ONLY on a genuinely-new result set, so set() IS the generation boundary; showing IS set() (no separate show()). Authoritative model text: spec/07-completion-ui.md:57–122.
2. INPUT: no new external data; existing seams only (state.highlightIndex, renderedCount() :1346–1350, decision-time stale-index clamp :1007). decideWidgetKey's only callers are widget.ts wiring and test/widget.test.ts:986–1057 — the signature change is contained (per system_context.md §'Ripple containment').
3. LOGIC: (a) Add `interacted: boolean` to WidgetStateInternal AND expose it on the exported WidgetState interface (tests read/drive it via widgetStateOf :318–321); init false in createWidgetState; reset to false inside set() (:304 site — covers every show / fresh generation) and defensively in hide() (:307–310). (b) Rewrite WidgetKeyDecision: replace `boundary-esc` with `boundary-pass-through`; DELETE `clamp`; keep navigate/escape/tab-insert/enter-submit/forward. (c) decideWidgetKey gains an `interacted` parameter (keep the function pure/table-testable; placed adjacent to highlightIndex, before keybindings). Implement the v2 decision table: !visible||count<=0 → forward; Escape at ANY state → escape (consumed, unchanged); un-interacted ↑/← at i===0 → boundary-pass-through (dismiss + suppress + forward verbatim); un-interacted →/↓ on a one-word line (count===1) → forward (line stays, no dismiss, no suppress); un-interacted →/↓ multi-word → navigate +1 (entering the list); interacted ↑/← at first → navigate wrapping to LAST; interacted →/↓ at last → navigate wrapping to FIRST; interior arrows → navigate ±1; Tab → tab-insert and submit key → enter-submit, both unchanged. Wrap may be expressed as delta ±(count−1) or as modular/absolute-target info on the decision — implementer's choice — BUT note the wiring pitfall in system_context.md: the existing navigate clamp (:1415–1420) nulls a wrap delta, so if the decision carries only a delta, P1.M1.T1.S2 must compute wrap modularly. All index math uses the RENDERED count param (width truncation shrinks the list). Defensive totality: un-interacted with i>0 (theoretically unreachable after reset-on-set-change) must degrade to a navigate decision that marks the generation interacted — NEVER to a forward. TDD implied workflow: rewrite the decision-table describes (test/widget.test.ts:986–1057, incl. stale-index clamp :1045 and single-item :1052) to pin every table cell first, then implement until green.
4. OUTPUT: updated WidgetKeyDecision union + decideWidgetKey(data, visible, count, highlightIndex, interacted, keybindings?) and WidgetState.interacted, consumed by P1.M1.T1.S2 (wiring) and pinned by P1.M1.T1.S3 (battery).
5. DOCS: [Mode A] JSDoc on WidgetKeyDecision (:976–983) and decideWidgetKey (:999–1018) describing the v2 table, and the WidgetState field docs (:278–286) incl. the new `interacted` field's generation semantics — updated in this same subtask; no separate docs subtask. No user-facing/config/API surface change beyond the exported type.

subtasks.title: widgetHandleInput wiring: boundary-pass-through branch, navigate wrap + interacted flag, comment sync
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: system_context.md §'widgetHandleInput branch map' + §'Tick seams' + §'Suppression seam' (verified at HEAD 23fd764). widgetHandleInput spans src/pi/widget.ts:1365–1493. The enter-submit branch (:1383–1399) is the EXACT precedent for dismiss-then-forward: try { state.hide(); machine.onDismissed(true); } catch {} then `return forwardInput(data)` — crucially it returns BEFORE the consumed-tick block (:1400–1413, opts.onKeystroke at :1409) so forwarded keys get their single tick from the guard's delegation seam (createEnterSubmitEditor tick, :1302–1317) instead. escape∥boundary-esc branch :1421–1429 (hide + onDismissed(true), consumed). navigate :1414–1420 uses CLAMP math that defeats wrap deltas. tab-insert + chain arming :1430–1460 (arms at rec.key, tier !== 0, fresh grant — :1457–1460; UNCHANGED). Old-model comments to rewrite: header model blurb :57–73, :1367 ('caret must not move on boundary-Esc/clamp'), :1480 ('clamp: consumed, no movement'), and boundary-Esc doc mentions at :331 (VisibilityState.suppressUntilWordStart) and :401 (onDismissed).
2. INPUT: the new decision union, decideWidgetKey signature (now taking interacted), and WidgetState.interacted from P1.M1.T1.S1.
3. LOGIC: (a) New boundary-pass-through branch shaped EXACTLY like enter-submit: try { state.hide(); machine.onDismissed(true); } catch { /* dismissal hiccups never break the press */ } then `return forwardInput(data)` — NOT consumed, NO widget-layer onKeystroke tick (the guard's delegation seam ticks exactly once; double-ticking corrupts hesitation timing). The press reaches the inner editor verbatim on the SAME keypress (plain-pi parity). (b) forward decision for un-interacted →/↓ on a one-word line: the existing forward path (:1382) already returns forwardInput with the line staying, no dismiss, no suppress — verify no accidental hide/tick. (c) navigate branch: apply the delta; at interacted edges land exactly on first/last of renderedCount() — if S1's decision carries only a delta, compute the wrap modularly (((i+delta) % count + count) % count); the old clamp math (:1415–1420) must not swallow wraps. Set state.interacted = true on EVERY navigate decision ('any arrow press that MOVES the highlight marks interacted' — marking on the decision also covers the defensive un-interacted i>0 corner). Consumed: keep exactly one widget-layer tick (:1409). (d) escape, tab-insert (incl. chain arming :1457–1460), enter-submit, forward branches: unchanged — only labels/comments shift for the renamed union. (e) Rewrite the stale comments listed in the research note to the v2 model (pass-through + carousel). No external services — the makeKeyHarness fakes already isolate editor/machine.
4. OUTPUT: wired v2 behavior for P1.M1.T1.S3's battery; observable seams: innerCalls receives the forwarded data verbatim, machine.getState().suppressUntilWordStart arms on pass-through, opts.onKeystroke called exactly once per press.
5. DOCS: [Mode A] header model blurb (:57–73), in-branch comments (:1367, :1480), and the :331/:401 doc mentions — all rewritten in this same subtask.

subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: system_context.md §'Test harness'. makeKeyHarness (test/widget.test.ts:~427–466): recording inner fake (`innerCalls` log, handleInput returns `inner:${data}`), never-mutate Proxy set-trap (`setHits()`), onKeystroke=vi.fn() clock counter, press() → editor.handleInput, show(displays) → state.set() directly (does NOT populate machine.painted()). Old-model blocks to rewrite: navigation/width-truncation describe (~:470, it ~:507), boundary-Esc describe (:526; its :527–541 and single-item :542–556), clamp describe (:558; it :559–574), input-clock describe (~:632, it ~:637), full-scenario never-mutate describe (:967, it :969 — KEEP the pin, update the scenario to v2), pure decision-table describes (:986–1057). File-header model blurb :14–20 also carries old-model prose.
2. INPUT: P1.M1.T1.S1's decideWidgetKey v2 (+ WidgetState.interacted, now readable/drivable in the harness) and P1.M1.T1.S2's wiring.
3. LOGIC: battery per spec/09:134–159 — (a) one-press pass-through: ↑/← on the first word un-interacted → line hidden, suppressUntilWordStart armed, AND innerCalls contains the verbatim data (caret-move parity on the same press); (b) →/↓ on a one-word un-interacted line → forwarded, line stays visible, NO suppression; (c) entering: →/↓ on a multi-word un-interacted line → highlightIndex +1 AND the interacted flag set; (d) carousel: interacted ↑/← at first wraps to the LAST rendered index; interacted →/↓ at last wraps to 0; interior arrows navigate ±1; every navigate/escape press consumed (no inner call); the clamp case class is GONE; (e) fresh generation: state.set(newDisplays) resets highlightIndex AND the flag, re-arms pass-through; a pass-through press never sets the flag (a one-word line therefore never becomes interacted); (f) Escape unchanged at every state (dismiss + suppress + consumed); Tab synchronous insert / Enter dismiss-then-forward unaffected by the flag; inner instance NEVER mutated (v1 regression pin — setHits()===0 across a full mixed scenario); (g) width truncation: 3 items at width 16 → 2 rendered; entering navigates to the rendered end (index 1), further →/↓ (now interacted) wraps to 0; (h) clock: navigate/escape → exactly ONE onKeystroke tick total; boundary-pass-through → exactly one tick total via the delegation seam and zero extra widget-layer ticks (the counter cannot distinguish layers — same observable shape as enter-submit/forward: assert total===1 AND innerCalls received the data). Delete/rewrite every old-model title or comment mentioning boundary-Esc, clamp, 'press CONSUMED', or 'caret unmoved'.
4. OUTPUT: green `npx vitest --run test/widget.test.ts` and full `npm test`; the battery enumerates every state×key cell of the v2 table. Suite counts feed P1.M2.T1.S2.
5. DOCS: [Mode A] test file header blurb (:14–20) and test titles/comments updated with the work — no user-facing/config/API surface change.

subtasks.title: Live smoke in tmux (4 scenarios) with capture-pane evidence — BINDING
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: external_deps.md §'Live verification technique' (spec/09:194–218 — BINDING). tmux pane; run `pi --no-session` (the TUI needs a real TTY — piping stdout exits silently). Seed the store: submit one short user message, then Ctrl+C the turn. Drive keys via `tmux send-keys` ONE character at a time with 0.08–0.12 s sleeps between (burst-typed strings cancel in-flight queries — a known false-conclusion source). Evidence via `tmux capture-pane`. Sanctioned internal probe: temporary appendFileSync behind an env var in src/pi/provider.ts — MUST be removed before finishing; `git status` clean afterward, no instrumentation left in the tree.
2. INPUT: implemented v2 behavior (P1.M1.T1.S1–S3) with a green gauntlet (P1.M2.T1.S2).
3. LOGIC: four scenarios per PRD R4: (i) un-entered ← mid-word — the caret moves one char AND the line dismisses on that SINGLE press (capture before/after); (ii) → on a one-word line passes through, line stays; (iii) → enters a multi-word line, ← at first wraps to last, → at last wraps to first, Escape exits, and the next word start re-offers; (iv) Tab still inserts and Enter still submits while the line is visible. No unit test substitutes for this — a key-handling change on the widget path requires live verification against the real extension stack (the v1 proxy crash is the precedent).
4. OUTPUT: capture-pane evidence for all four scenarios (pacing noted) handed to P1.M2.T1.S4; clean tree.
5. DOCS: none directly — captures land in the DoD gauntlet item (P1.M2.T1.S4).
